lesson.title: Applying for a job

lines: 3.8 Applying for a job
Read this job advertisement and think about the job requirements. Then do activities A and B in the Workbook.
ADULT EDUCATION DEVELOPMENT WORKER

The Ministry of Education is looking for a confident and well-educated individual to work locally in their adult education programme. The post involves teaching adults with learning difficulties in their own homes, so a driving licence is desirable. The successful applicants will have good communication skills, experience of teaching and be computer literate.
Age range: 21-25
Starting salary: £18,000-£19,500 pa according to experience
Apply in writing to: Mrs Jill Castle • PO Box 0086 • London S9 3OK
content.caption: Ministry of Education job advertisement (PB page 22)

blocks.edu_note_html: ملاحظة استخراجية: الشريط الداكن أسفل الإعلان (Age range / Starting salary / Apply in writing) مضمَّن كصورة لم يستخرجها pdftotext، وقد استُخرج بصرياً عبر تكبير 400 DPI (`pb22_ad_zoom.png`) لمطابقة أسئلة WB 3.8 A & B.

lines: Now read the letters of application below. How well do the applicants fit the requirements of the job?
--- Letter 1: Kate Ash (Miss) ---
17 Wood Road, Manchester M29 4TF | Mrs Jill Castle, PO Box 0086, London S9 30K | March 18
Dear Mrs Castle, I am interested in applying for the teaching post advertisement in today's Daily News.

I am 24 years old and am a qualified Primary School teacher. I have taught since I was 21 and have worked in different parts of the country. I have also had training in adult education and for the past six months I have been doing evening classes for adults with learning difficulties. I have been using computers in this work. Furthermore I have, recently passed the driving test. My present salary is £15,000 per annum.
I look forward to hearing from you in the near future and would you be grateful for the chance of attending an interview.
Yours sincerely, Kate Ash (Miss)
--- Letter 2: Tim Brook ---
140 Tower Road, Liverpool L9 9QZ | Mrs Jill Castle, PO Box 0086, London S9 30K | March 20
Dear Mrs. Castle, I am writing to apply for the job of teacher as advertised in the Daily News of March 18.

I am 23 years old and have been working in adult education for two years. As a result, I have had a lot of experience in this field. I have had a full driving licence for three years. Although I have no experience of working on computers, I am very willing to learn. At the moment I am earning £21,000 a year.
I look forward to hearing from you. Yours sincerely, Tim Brook
Now do activity C in the Workbook.

blocks.edu_note_html: ملاحظات نقل حرفي: حُفظت الصيغ المطبوعة في رسالة كيت: post advertisement وI have, recently passed وwould you be grateful ورمز الصفر في S9 30K كما طُبعت في PB ص 22.

interactive_spot.label: المفاضلة الموضوعية بين Kate Ash وTim Brook

simple_explain.html:
• المتطلبات الأساسية للإعلان: العمر (21–25)، تعليم الكبار، رخصة قيادة (مرغوبة)، مهارات تواصل وخبرة تدريس، وإلمام بالحاسوب (computer literate)؛ والراتب المبدئي £18,000–£19,500.
  • Kate Ash (24 سنة): تحقّق كل الشروط المطلوبة (معلّمة مؤهلة، 6 أشهر تدريس كبار ذوي صعوبات تعلم، تستخدم الحاسوب، اجتازت فحص القيادة، راتبها الحالي £15,000 فتناسب الراتب المعروض) — مع بعض الأخطاء الإملائية الطفيفة في رسالتها.
  • Tim Brook (23 سنة): خبرة أطول في تعليم الكبار (سنتان) والقيادة (3 سنوات)، ورسالته أنقى لغوياً، لكنه يفتقر لشرط الحاسوب وراتبه الحالي (£21,000) أعلى من سقف الوظيفة المعروض (£19,500)!

example.html: Key contrast: Kate uses computers (required) and earns £15,000; Tim earns £21,000 and has no computer experience.

Yours sincerely.ar: مع فائق التقدير (ختام رسالة باسم معروف)

furthermore.ar: علاوةً على ذلك / فضلاً عن ذلك

activities.prompt_literal: 3.8 A Answer these questions about the advertisement on PB page 22. [Note: Q3 literally prints 'driving license']
activities.prompt_ar: أجب عن الأسئلة الستة المتعلقة بإعلان التوظيف (1–5 في ص 36، و6 في ص 37):

items.question: What kind of work would applicants have to do in this job?
items.model_answer: Teaching adults with learning difficulties locally in their own homes (in an adult education programme).
items.explain_ar: مذكورة صراحةً في الجملة الثانية من الإعلان.

items.question: Should a Primary School teacher apply for this job? Why? Why not?
items.model_answer: Yes, if they have experience of teaching and can work with adults (the ad asks for 'experience of teaching' generally, and Kate Ash herself is a Primary teacher with evening adult-class experience).
items.explain_ar: المشروط خبرة التدريس عموماً والمهارات المطلوبة دون منع معلّمي المرحلة الابتدائية.

items.question: Why should applicants have a driving license?
items.model_answer: Because they have to visit and teach adults locally in their own homes.
items.explain_ar: العبارة الحرفية: involves teaching adults ... in their own homes, so a driving licence is desirable.

items.question: Should somebody who is 24 apply? Why? Why not?
items.model_answer: Yes, because 24 falls inside the advertised age range of 21-25.
items.explain_ar: انظر الشريط البنفسجي في الإعلان: Age range: 21-25.

items.question: Should applicants telephone to ask for an application? Why? Why not?
items.model_answer: No, because the advertisement states 'Apply in writing to: Mrs Jill Castle • PO Box 0086...' (and no phone number is given).

items.question: (WB p. 37) Do you think that is a worthwhile job? Why? Why not?
items.model_answer: Yes, because helping adults with learning difficulties improves their reading, writing and everyday independence.
items.explain_ar: سؤال رأي وتعليل مرتبط بمفهوم الوظيفة ذات القيمة في 3.2.

hints: أرقام 4 و5 تعتمد على قراءة الشريط الداكن أسفل الإعلان (Age range وApply in writing).

activities.prompt_literal: B Find other ways of saying the following (from PB page 22):
activities.prompt_ar: استخرج العبارة المرادفة من إعلان أو رسائل PB ص 22 لكل بند (1–6):

items.prompt: 1 somebody who has been to college or university: ______
2 In this job you have to help adults learn how to read and write better: ______
3 It would be useful if the applicant could drive a car: ______
4 The applicant should be able to explain things to people clearly: ______

hints: 1–4 من فقرة الإعلان، و5–6 من الشريط البنفسجي السفلي (pa = per annum = سنوياً، وتظهر أيضاً per annum في رسالة Kate وa year في رسالة Tim).

activities.prompt_literal: C Answer these questions about the letters on PB page 22. Write 'K' for Kate or 'T' for Tim. Then: Who do you think is the better applicant? Why?
activities.prompt_ar: قارن بين كيت (K) وتيم (T) في البنود 1–6 مع التعليل للسؤال الختامي:

items.question: 1 Who wrote first?
items.model_answer: K (Kate wrote on March 18; Tim wrote on March 20).
items.explain_ar: تاريخ رسالة Kate هو 18 مارس، بينما Tim يوم 20 مارس.

items.question: 3 Who has been working with adults longer?
items.model_answer: T (Tim has worked in adult education for two years; Kate for six months).
items.explain_ar: سنتان عند تيم مقابل ستة أشهر عند كيت.

items.question: 4 Who has more experience of computers?
items.model_answer: K (Kate has been using computers; Tim has no experience of working on computers).
items.explain_ar: كيت تستخدم الحاسوب في عملها، وتيم ليست لديه أي خبرة بالحاسوب.

items.question: 5 Who has been driving longer?
items.model_answer: T (Tim has had a full driving licence for three years; Kate recently passed her test).
items.explain_ar: ثلاث سنوات عند تيم مقابل نجاح حديث لكيت.

items.question: 6 Who has the better-paid job at the moment?
items.model_answer: T (Tim earns £21,000 a year; Kate earns £15,000 per annum).

items.question: Who do you think is the better applicant? Why?
items.model_answer: Kate Ash is generally the stronger match because she meets ALL stated criteria—adult education experience, teaching qualification, driving licence, AND computer literacy—and her current salary (£15,000) fits the advertised pay (£18,000–£19,500), whereas Tim lacks computer experience and earns more (£21,000) than the offered salary (though Tim has longer adult-teaching experience and fewer writing slips).
items.explain_ar: الموازنة المنهجية: كيت تستوفي شرط الحاسوب والراتب، بينما يمتاز تيم بطول الخبرة ونقاء كتابة الرسالة.

questions.stem: According to PB page 22 and WB p. 37 (3.8 B #6), what does the abbreviation 'pa' mean in 'Starting salary: £18,000–£19,500 pa'?

options.why_wrong: pa اختصار اللاتينية per annum أي سنوياً، وقد ذكرتها كيت كاملةً 'per annum' في رسالتها.
العنوان البريدي مذكور بعد عبارة Apply in writing to.
pa تتصل بالراتب وتعادل 'for the year' في WB ص 37.

hints: قارن عبارة الإعلان (£18,000-£19,500 pa) بعبارة Kate (£15,000 per annum) وWB 3.8 B #6 (for the year).
الصحيح: Per annum / for the year.
questions.explain: الاختصار pa هو الأحرف الأولى من per annum ويعني سنوياً (for the year).

questions.stem: Which advertised requirement in PB page 22 does Tim Brook NOT currently meet?

options.text: Being computer literate (he admits 'no experience of working on computers')

options.why_wrong: عمر تيم 23 عاماً، وهو داخل النطاق المطلوب 21–25.
تيم يحمل رخصة قيادة كاملة منذ ثلاث سنوات.
يعمل تيم في تعليم الكبار منذ سنتين.

hints: اقرأ الفقرة الثانية من رسالة Tim Brook (يسار/يمين الصفحة 22) عند جملة Although...
questions.explain: يعترف تيم في رسالته أنه لا يملك أي خبرة في العمل على الحواسيب (Although I have no experience of working on computers).
